feature_mapping_quality_caveat.note: Post-hoc review against nProbe's authoritative NetFlow field documentation (https://www.ntop.org/guides/nprobe/flow_information_elements.html) revealed that 8 of the 21 mapped features are semantic mismatches — the NetFlow and CICFlowMeter fields measure different physical quantities. The remaining 13 pairs are genuinely equivalent (7 exact, 5 approximate). This means the 'schema mismatch eliminated' premise is only partially met: while zero features were zero-filled, ~38% of mapped features were feeding semantically incorrect data. The cross-dataset failure is likely caused by a combination of residual schema mismatch AND distributional shift, rather than distributional shift alone.
